scope: TRAIN only. Frozen C82 research counterpart and C92 full order-3 H/TX physical predictor. No blended scores or fitted fusion weights. One map each, 80 calibration / 48 development-selection / 484 locked confirmation terrains, same preselected 512 uniform pixels each. Additional held-out one-metre neighborhood challenge selected before reading labels.
positive: Valid band pixel with released PL minus BOTH C82 and C92 PL >=5 dB, i.e. both predict excess received power. Report 3/8 dB sensitivity. Separately report (a) strict clear conservative FSPL+3 weak and neither called it and (b) local fade among primary events >3 dB weaker than same-band median of valid neighbors at 2-4m, >=12 supporting valid neighbors, and (c) true local dips missed by both relative to their respective neighbors in the dense patch (only where available). Predictions and masks for cohort/scoring only. Record both bands, states and dual-valid overlap.
prediction: Only heightmap and TX allowed at inference. Test (1) analytic incidence and physical area, (2) subpixel projected aperture, earlier receiver sheet folds and sensitivity to spawned ray offset, (3) fixed neighboring-terrain exemplar transfer from disjoint TRAIN calibration, not a learned operator. Calibrate query event probability and pathloss using fixed nearest-neighbor reference or bins from 80 TRAIN terrains, with 48 selecting among predeclared descriptors, freeze before confirmation. No validation targets/true mask nor C82/C92 fields fed into detector. Controls include simple range/state, wrong incident azimuth or location displaced, within-scene/coarse-state matched negatives, compare against ranking chance and known positives. Score AP, precision, recall, exact location and depth MAE/RMSE (including all misses), joint recall with +/-1 dB, and outcome if physically targeted predictions replace C82 at predicted positions. Never correct only known positives to claim blind improvement.
coverage: Quantify pooled C82 SSE contribution and oracle that corrects only true primary shared misses exactly. Check positive and negative endpoints valid against official TRAIN arrays. Compute complete baseline sampled scores and record cohorts in CSV; pair bootstrap at terrain level. Set deterministic seeds, verify no calibration-confirm overlap and output duplicate keys.
gate: Formal model training only if stand-alone detector on both 48 selection and 484 confirmation terrains shows exact pixel precision and recall >=0.30 each at frozen calibration operating point on each band, depth MAE on true misses falls by >=1 dB vs C82, and automatic local repair (no oracle or blending, all false alerts counted) lowers sampled RMSE >=0.08 dB in both bands. At-least-.30 dB dual official large gain target, both official <=1 dB ultimate. A bookkeeping probe or transplanted conditional frequencies is not a model training run.
budget: All work CC; if GPU needed only run_gpu.sh 1/3/4 with verified UUID. No new gradient training before gate. No official VAL used.
